crossRefs.note: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
“You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you…
Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of…
for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying…
They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. Desolation and…
For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.
As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.
“They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit, and kill him.

translations.web: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.
translations.bsb: Destruction is within; oppression and deceit never leave the streets.
translations.kjv: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
translations.asv: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: Oppression and guile depart not from its streets.
